name: Blight
description:
Way of the Spore

Choose a creature within short range. You drain moisture and vitality from it.

Roll Spirit vs Fortitude. On a win, the target takes 8d8+HEART damage. On a loss, half damage. This spell has no effect on undead or constructs.

If you target a plant creature, its roll is Ill-Favored and the spell automatically deals maximum damage to it. If you target an ordinary plant, it simply withers and dies.
successes:
✨: +1d damage.

🌞: You regain Endurance equal to half the damage dealt.
